changes: Aligned list-page title, typography, colors, filters, table framing and pagination with the Standard Window 1 UI discipline.
Removed redundant eyebrow labels and descriptive subtitles from the affected first pages.
Kept Follow-ups and Appointments summary cards in their existing position; preserved Calendar month navigation and grid.
Kept app-specific create, refresh, search, filters, actions and detail workflows where present; did not add actions where the app did not need them.
scope.shared_ui: packages/dental-ui/src/shared/standard-app-page.css plus opt-in standardPage styling on Page and ClinicDataTable

source.note: Packages were built from the implementation changes in this worktree, including uncommitted UI, app version, package policy, and test updates. No commit was created.

staging.public_readback: Passed; signatures, freshness, exact package bytes and grants verified. Each package was installed, launched, health-marked and uninstalled in an isolated local PackageRegistry.
staging.authenticated_store_install: Not performed for these UI updates.
staging.running_os: Not restarted; its current in-memory build does not include the new four-release policy allowance or app packages.

platform_policy.change: Raised the maximum retained signed API release grants per app from three to four so Patient Record can retain all existing grants and receive version 1.0.3.
platform_policy.compatibility: A host still enforcing the previous three-grant maximum must be rebuilt before it can accept the resulting signed policy.
platform_policy.build: Root Electron production build passed after the policy change.

verification.app_builds: All seven production bundles built successfully; app typechecks passed where package scripts provide them.
verification.private_ui: All seven M17-specific UI fixtures passed on private headless Linux displays: Follow-ups 20, Appointments 21, Work Entry 11, Patient Record 22, Treatment Progress 23, Treatment Protocols 18, Calendar 16 checks.
verification.root_unit_tests: Passed: 527/527 tests across 37 files via npm test -- --maxWorkers=1.
verification.docs_check: Passed: python3 tools/check-dental-docs.py; no documentation structure or ownership errors.
limitations: Private UI fixtures use synthetic in-memory data and do not establish live clinic acceptance.
The public feed readback and isolated PackageRegistry lifecycle do not prove authenticated Dental OS Store installation or runtime health on a user device.
The legacy test:followups launcher fixture timed out looking for an old shell button label; the M17-specific Follow-ups UI fixture passed.

releases.release_history: 1.0.2 at sequence 43 was superseded after private UI testing found a React hook-order crash; corrected 1.0.3 is the current release.
